private_lines.Maya: You are juggling month-end close for two client families in Headingley while your mum's hip surgery recovery means you're driving to Harrogate every evening after work.
private_lines.Tom: You are the one who keeps the supplier spreadsheets for the firm, and this week you're camped out at your allotment in Armley most evenings, trying to finish the shed roof before the rain sets in.
private_lines.Jo: You are a part-time bookkeeper who also teaches Thursday night pottery classes in Chapel Allerton, and you're preparing a glaze firing that has to come out before the weekend.
private_lines.Sam: You are newly qualified and nervous, living in a shared flat in Hyde Park, and this week you're sitting your first solo payroll run while your landlord keeps chasing the deposit paperwork.

setting: You all live in Leeds and know each other from working together at a small accounts firm on Park Row, where you've shared the same back-office floor for three years.
